name: AI Network
description: An initiative to provide an AI community for SciLifeLab researchers and infrastructure users by encouraging collaboration and the sharing of emerging technologies.

name: CoARA
description: SciLifeLab is a proud member of CoARA, a global coalition dedicated to reforming how research, researchers, and institutions are assessed. CoARA promotes the recognition of diverse research contributions.

name: Global Alliance for Genomics and Health (GA4GH)
description: SciLifeLab collaborates with GA4GH to advance responsible sharing of genomic and health data through harmonised standards and tools.
search_tags: Global Alliance for Genomics and Health

name: ADORE.software
description: SciLifeLab is a signatory of ADORE.software initiative. This declaration emphasises the importance of skilled individuals, supportive infrastructure, and effective funding policies for long-term software impact
search_tags: Amsterdam Declaration on Funding Research Software Sustainability

name: LIFES/GoFAIR Sweden
description: SciLifeLab collaborates with GoFAIR Sweden to promote FAIR principles in data management and sharing and to foster collaboration among Swedish institutions to make life science data more FAIR.

name: The Open Science Monitoring Initiative (OSMI)
description: SciLifeLab partners with OSMI to connect individuals and institutions working to implement and advanced Open Science monitoring.

name: SciLifeLab Open Science Monitor
description: A service that provides a transparent, aggregated view of research outputs affiliated with, hosted by, or enabled through SciLifeLab infrastructures and services. Powered by the OpenAIRE Graph.

name: European Open Science Cloud (EOSC)
description: SciLifeLab is collaborating with EOSC to help build a federated and open environment for sharing and reusing research data, tools, and services across Europe.

name: nf-core
description: SciLifeLab is a founding member of nf-core;  a community effort to enhance reproducibility and collaboration by collating a curated set of analysis pipelines and modules.
